\begin{center}
\begin{tabular}{@{}ll@{}}
\toprule
Symbol & Meaning \\
\midrule
$B_d$ & open cubical block with vertices $\{0,1,2\}^d$ \\
$e$ & selected full-degree direction-$1$ link \\
$m=2(d-1)$ & number of plaquettes incident to $e$ \\
$G$ & compact connected Lie group with bi-invariant metric \\
$z$ & fixed nonidentity central element \\
$L=\operatorname{dist}(\mathbf1,z)$ & central displacement \\
$p_t$ & heat kernel of $\tfrac12\Delta$ based at $\mathbf1$ \\
$S_p$ & oriented staple defined by $p_t(U_eS_p)$ \\
$b_*=(m-1)L/m$ & target distance on the minimizing set \\
$\rho$ & target good-curvature radius, with $0<\rho<b_*$ \\
$\gamma_{e,t}^{\omega}$ & continuous one-link conditional kernel \\
$c_{ab}(t)$ & total-variation Dobrushin coefficient \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{center}
